question: For molecules containing triple bonds, calculate the percentage that are carcinogenic. Additionally, identify all distinct elements that are connected to nitrogen atoms through any bond type in carcinogenic molecules.

prediction.sql:
WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE b.XCL_006 = '#'
),
carcinogenic_tb_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_010
    FROM molecule AS m
    INNER JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS tbm ON m.XCL_010 = tbm.XCL_010
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
),
percentage_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ctm.XCL_010) AS REAL) * 100 / 
        (CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT tbm.XCL_010) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT tbm.XCL_010) END) AS percentage
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS tbm
    LEFT JOIN carcinogenic_tb_molecules AS ctm ON tbm.XCL_010 = ctm.XCL_010
),
nitrogen_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
    FROM atom AS a
    INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'n' AND m.XCL_011 = '+'
),
connected_elements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_003
    FROM connected AS c
    INNER JOIN nitrogen_atoms AS na ON c.XCL_007 = na.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
)
SELECT 
    pc.percentage,
    ce.XCL_003 AS element
FROM percentage_calc AS pc
CROSS JOIN connected_elements AS ce
